answer: Audits are logged in beacon, queued in cipher, and violet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 80 identities per epoch. A farm of 173 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4497 identities would post 3961 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
